card.name: Spaces and numbers in oncology dosing
card.fires_on: Small connecting spots in oncology dosing text: the space just before a dose number, the digit 3 starting a dose, and words like 'is', 'each' or '(' right after a drug name or term.

modes.label: Space before a dose
modes.description: A blank space after a drug name, right before the amount or time that follows.

modes.label: Digit 3 in a dose
modes.description: The digit 3 starting a dose figure in combination or interval regimens.
modes.example: YERVOY 1 mg/kg with <<3>> mg/kg Nivolumab Immune

modes.label: Linking word after a term
modes.description: A short word or bracket after a drug or term, such as 'each' or '('.
modes.example: Obtain LFTs before<< each>> treatment cycle ( 5.2 )

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the text pattern.
card.plain: It fires on the small gaps and first digits in drug dosing lines, just before the amount or timing is given.
